turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Sure. Rule: he / she / it + verb-s. But careful: verbs ending in -sh, -ch, -s, -x or -o take -es (go - goes).

Try this: My brother ___ (go) to the gym on Fridays.
Answer with only the verb.
